title: Computation with integers
summary: Adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing whole numbers and negative integers, number properties, prime factors and the order of operations.

cards.title: Adding and subtracting
cards.rule: Line up the place values, then carry or borrow. Rounding first can make it easier in your head.

cards.title: Multiplying and dividing
cards.rule: Split the number into parts you can multiply, then add the parts.

cards.title: Number properties
cards.rule: Order doesn't matter for + and ×: \(a + b = b + a\). Brackets can be expanded: \(a(b + c) = ab + ac\).

cards.title: Divisibility and prime factorisation
cards.rule: Divisible by 2: even. By 3: digits add to a multiple of 3. By 5: ends in 0 or 5. By 9: digits add to a multiple of 9.
lines: 1 is not a prime number. 2 is the only even prime.

cards.title: Negative integers
cards.rule: Numbers get smaller as you move left on the number line.
lines: A temperature of −3°C is colder than 2°C

cards.title: Adding and subtracting negatives
cards.rule: Adding a negative means subtract. Subtracting a negative means add.

cards.title: Multiplying and dividing negatives
cards.rule: Same signs give a positive. Different signs give a negative.
lines: \(-2 \times (-3) \times (-1) = -6\): an odd number of negatives gives a negative

cards.title: Order of operations and substitution
cards.rule: Brackets, then powers, then × and ÷ from left to right, then + and − from left to right.
cards.tip: put negative numbers in brackets when you substitute.
